title: Watched folders
subtitle: Import new files from folders on the server automatically
containerHint: D-cubby runs in a container. It sees the server folder you chose for watched folders during installation (WATCHED_FOLDERS_PATH) at /watched, so every path here starts with /watched — for example /watched/photos.
emptyBody: Add a folder and D-cubby will import the files placed in it.
confirmDelete: Stop watching this folder? Files already imported stay in the library.
inaccessibleHint: D-cubby can't read this path. Check that it exists under /watched and that the folder is readable.

actions.notifications: {count, plural, one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

form.pathHint: A path inside the container, under /watched. Subfolders of your watched-folders directory on the server appear there.
form.autoTagsHint: Comma-separated. Every file imported from this folder gets these tags.

history.title: Scan history
history.emptyHint: Scans appear here once the folder has been checked.
history.processed: Imported {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
history.skipped: Skipped {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} already imported

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Problems importing files from this folder are listed here.
